§ 01 · The Program

Real rooms,
real decisions.

From leading a board meeting and handling tough questions from executives, to facilitating workshops, communicating a crisis, and presenting strategic recommendations to the board, every scenario drops you into a genuine communication situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Sixty foundations-focused scenarios and forty leadership-and-high-stakes-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real communication judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a professional faces in a meeting or presentation — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across meetings, presentations, facilitation, crisis communication, and executive communication.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound communication judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

Choose your
scenario.

Every scenario contains 10 decision-making questions, a focused introduction, key communication and meeting terms to learn, and a practical tip. Search, filter by Foundations or Scale, and go at your own pace.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Communication Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping professionals communicate and lead meetings clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in communication isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already lead, or aspire to lead, meetings and presentations in English — Mr. Gad Corporate Communication & Meetings is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the communication moments you'll actually face.
